lamellar_parseval.definitions: On normalized T1 let s(t)=sgn(sin t) and p_R(t)=(4/pi) sum_{r=0}^R sin((2r+1)t)/(2r+1)
lamellar_parseval.sign_lemma: The Dirichlet-integral positivity lemma gives sgn(p_R)=s almost everywhere; the derivative of the unscaled sum is sin(2(R+1)t)/(2sin t)
lamellar_parseval.uniform_bound: The same alternating Dirichlet-integral representation gives ||p_R||_infinity<=C_0 for one universal C_0 independent of R
lamellar_parseval.scope_guard: This is an exact approximation identity for the one-coordinate odd-harmonic family, not a Gaussian capacity estimate or a theorem for arbitrary three-dimensional sign textures
